summary: The reviewed browser path reads live engine and host files and writes both capture and final output before helper authentication and prefix freeze, while the helper later attempts to write that same final output. Qualification must instead use one final-output writer after authenticated engine, host, and browser prefixes are complete and frozen; bounded attributable capture must precede normalization. This is retained historical BAR knowledge at the cited capture; recheck applicability before using it on a successor.
title: Authenticated stock evidence requires frozen inputs and one final writer
